Definition: the shrine or innermost part of the sanctuary
BiblicalUsage: 1) the holy of holies, the innermost room of the temple or tabernacle; 1a) hindmost chamber, innermost room of the temple of Solomon, most holy place, holy of holies; 2) (TWOT) oracle
